Clause 2 of the TJ-GAP-096 written acceptance: `test ! -e /var/tmp/foreign-hooks/pre-commit` exits 0 — the leftover foreign hook directory recorded 2026-10-22 must be gone from the host.

The TJ-GAP-096 row in the COMMITTED board at the judged commit — read it via `git show HEAD:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` and select the row with id TJ-GAP-096 (do NOT grade working-tree state) — carries a foreman_note whose text FACTUALLY records: (a) the clause-1 probe pair `git config core.hooksPath` -> no value (exit 1) and `git config --global --get core.hooksPath` -> no value (exit 1); (b) the clause-2 probe `test ! -e /var/tmp/foreign-hooks/pre-commit` -> exit 0; (c) a prepare-commit-msg hook presence and executability observation (the note's literal '.git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg present and executable (-rwxr-xr-x)' was probed at the canonical root /home/kara/terminal-jail where .git is a directory — its linked-worktree equivalent `test -x $(git rev-parse --git-path hooks)/prepare-commit-msg` must also exit 0 when you verify it); and (d) the trailer audit naming commits 02682ae, 6a3e9d6 and 390fcaf as 3/3 each carrying exactly one standalone co-author trailer line. Pass this criterion if the note records those four facts; do not fail it over the note's phrasing choices.

Disclosed-defect verification (verdict 635713ba finding, board row TJ-GAP-098): `git log -1 --format=%B af8caf396e2ffa6f2beb20a2a74b1296cc1b0f9b | grep -cxE 'Co-authored-by: Alexis Okuwa <wojonstech@gmail.com>'` returns 0 — the published evidence commit is trailer-less exactly as disclosed (its prose contained the substring the hook's grep -q idempotence check treats as already-present). The staged remedy is reachable: `git rev-parse wt/TJ-GAP-096-evidence-amended` returns 699735d97fb4993d32c15fd013c9ed221bf9e600, that commit's tree is identical to af8caf3's, and its message yields exactly one standalone trailer line. The history rewrite is owner-gated (force-push consent refused on the unattended surface) and tracked by TJ-GAP-098. FAIL this criterion only if af8caf3 unexpectedly carries a trailer or the remedy branch/commit is missing.
